intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Joplin for 2026, and here is what he found: 12 family events, 5 of them free. The magic runs from A Victorian Christmas at Joplin Historical Neighborhoods Museum (opening November 27) through the Polar Bear Express in Webb City (final night December 19), with the CPKC Holiday Train (November 28), the Joplin Christmas Parade (December 1), the Holiday Tree Trail Kickoff (December 3) and Lightwire Theater (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Joplin

  • 12 Christmas events for kids in Joplin, including nearby Webb City and Monett
  • 5 free events, including the Joplin Christmas Parade, Grinch, Attorney at Law, the Holiday Tree Trail Kickoff and the Webb City and Monett parades
  • Meet Santa: Holiday Tree Trail Kickoff (December 3), Breakfast with Santa at the Joplin History and Mineral Museum (December 5) and the Polar Bear Express at King Jack Park in Webb City (December 3 to 19)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Joplin Christmas Parade (December 1), Webb City Historic Downtown Christmas Parade (December 2), Holiday Tree Trail Kickoff (December 3) and Monett Christmas Parade (December 12)
  • Trains: the CPKC Holiday Train at Joplin Union Depot (November 28) and the Polar Bear Express in Webb City (December 3 to 19)
  • Christmas shows: Lightwire Theater (December 5), I'll Be Home for Christmas at Joplin Little Theatre (December 10 to 13) and Grinch, Attorney at Law (December 11 and 12)
  • Season: November 27 to December 19

Planning a bigger day out? Joplin families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Springfield, which covers Santa's Wonderland at Bass Pro Shops, Gardens Aglow and The Nutcracker.
